rules.heading: A new plan is drawn on the top tier
rules.quote: The plan check faults a plan last written by a reply served below the top tier (the model read from the transcript, judged as the status print judges a top-tier id) unless the approval marker names a plan with a step of its Order open
rules.says: The plan check faults a plan last written by a reply served below the top tier, the model being read from the transcript and judged as the status print judges a top-tier id.
rules.live_quote: The top tier is for the scope and for a surprise that needs judgement; a lower tier holds the run after approval.
rules.missing: The plan check that faults a plan last written by a reply served below the top tier (model read from the transcript, judged as the status print judges). Live text only says the top tier is for the scope.

rules.heading: A new plan is drawn on the top tier
rules.quote: unless the approval marker names a plan with a step of its Order open, so an amendment stays on its running tier.
rules.says: The top-tier requirement does not apply when the approval marker names a plan with a step of its Order open, so an amendment of a running plan stays on its running tier.

rules.heading: A new plan is drawn on the top tier
rules.quote: It stays on it though plan mode has removed the marker: the previous approval kept beside it, with the plan's title, says the plan is the same and its Order has a step open (Q-HUB-412).
rules.says: Even after plan mode has removed the approval marker, an amendment stays on its running tier, because the previous approval kept beside it, with the plan's title, shows the plan is the same and its Order has a step open.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: At the entry to plan mode on a lower tier with no plan in force, the reply says in its first line that the plan needs the top tier and ends as a declared stop.
rules.says: When plan mode is entered on a tier below the top with no plan in force, the reply's first line says the plan needs the top tier and the reply ends as a declared stop.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 5. **A line before each tool call and a line after each result.**
rules.says: The session writes one line before each tool call and one line after each result.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 6. **Never "waiting on you", never "you owe", never a line saying nothing is open while the session is paused on the owner.**
rules.says: A reply never says "waiting on you" or "you owe", and never says nothing is open while the session is paused on the owner.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Every reply ends with the state line in one of its fixed forms: State, then paused, pending the owner's go-word; or paused, pending the button on the plan;
rules.says: Every reply ends with a state line in one of the fixed forms: paused pending the owner's go-word, paused pending the button on the plan, paused pending the owner's answer to the choice above, running with the step and nothing pending from the owner, or finished with nothing pending from the owner.
rules.live_quote: Report what changed and what it means, in plain words, with the state at the end: finished, paused on what, or running what.
rules.missing: The fixed forms of the state line (paused pending the go-word, the plan button, or the answer to the choice above; running with the step and nothing pending from the owner; finished with nothing pending) and that every reply ends with one.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A stop is declared in the first line as "Stopping here", then paused, pending what lifts it, or finished, nothing pending.
rules.says: A stop is declared in the reply's first line as "Stopping here", followed by paused pending what lifts it, or finished with nothing pending.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: "Open for you:" lists decisions only and never a pause.
rules.says: The "Open for you:" list holds decisions only and never names a pause.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The blame shapes stay refused: waiting on you, you owe, and the owner named as the reason a thing stopped.
rules.says: A reply never uses the blame shapes: waiting on you, you owe, or the owner named as the reason a thing stopped.
rules.live_quote: ## 5b. When a tool fails, diagnose it — never hand the owner the blame
rules.missing: The ban on the reply shapes: waiting on you, you owe, and the owner named as the reason a thing stopped. 5b covers only blame for a failed tool call.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 7. **A limit is reported only after every route available was tried**, with the failed attempt named. A blocked host is a question, not a finding.
rules.says: A limit is reported only after every available route has been tried, with the failed attempt named, and a blocked host is raised as a question and not reported as a finding.
rules.live_quote: ### 15c. A DENIED HOST IS A QUESTION FOR THE OWNER, NEVER A FINDING. ASK FOR IT BY NAME.
rules.missing: The general rule that any limit (not only network) is reported only after every available route was tried, with the failed attempt named. Only the network case is stated (15b probe order, 15c).

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: *Enforced for declined hosts by:* `reply-guard.mjs` (Q-HUB-294), which records a host as declined by the proxy on curl's CONNECT failure with a 403 or the proxy's no-rule line, and `report.mjs`, whose status prints the hosts declined since the last status, one per line in one fenced block.
rules.says: A host counts as declined by the proxy on curl's CONNECT failure with a 403 or the proxy's no-rule line, and the status prints the hosts declined since the last status, one per line in one fenced block.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 8. **A defect of the session is a bug**, never framed as the owner's preference or "your rule".
rules.says: A defect of the session is called a bug and is never framed as the owner's preference or as "your rule".

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 9. **When the harness says ultracode is off, the first line of the next reply says so.** On 2026-09-28 it said so twice while ultracode was on: that notice is a harness bug. Say so, and carry on with ultracode on.
rules.says: When the harness says ultracode is off, the next reply's first line says so, and that notice is treated as a harness bug (it was wrong on 2026-09-28) so the session carries on with ultracode on.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 10. **Questions to the owner are real decisions only.** Never something the record already ranks, never research handed back.
rules.says: Questions to the owner are real decisions only, never something the record already ranks and never research handed back.
rules.live_quote: Bring back to the owner only a choice that is the owner's, with the recommended option first.
rules.missing: That a question is never research handed back. The 'record already ranks' part is only reached through page.md:13 (a choice is offered only where the record cannot rank the options).

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A choice is checked against the record each time it is served, and a choice whose recommended option breaks a rule of this doctrine is not a choice.**
rules.says: A choice is checked against the record each time it is served, and a choice whose recommended option breaks a rule of the doctrine is not a choice.
rules.live_quote: A choice is offered only where each option leaves the work whole and the record cannot rank them.
rules.missing: That a choice is checked against the record each time it is served, and that a choice whose recommended option breaks a rule of the doctrine is not a choice.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The open choice goes first in a reply until it is answered, and a turn a hook forces while one stands open puts it first again,
rules.says: The open choice goes first in every reply until it is answered, including a turn a hook forces while it stands open.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: At each serving the record is read for whether it settles the matter; if it does, the item is acted on or dropped, and an option that skips what this doctrine requires
rules.says: At each serving of a choice the record is read for whether it settles the matter; if it does the item is acted on or dropped, and an option that skips what the doctrine requires (a status page republished only at a plan's end, a commit identity changed on a reading) is struck and not recommended.
rules.enforcer: none (no gate can read whether a record settles a matter, LESSONS §465)

rules.heading: Rule 10: questions to the owner
rules.quote: No gate can read whether a record settles a matter (LESSONS §465).
rules.says: No gate can tell whether the record settles a matter, so the session itself must read the record at each serving of a choice.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 11. **Search the whole codebase before saying a name is real or invented.** A partial search reported as a fact is the defect, in either direction.
rules.says: The whole codebase is searched before a session says a name is real or invented, and a partial search reported as fact is a defect in either direction.
rules.enforcer: plan-guard.mjs (a plan naming code that exists nowhere is refused)

rules.heading: Rule 11: search the whole codebase
rules.quote: *Enforced by:* `plan-guard.mjs` (a plan naming code that exists nowhere is refused).
rules.says: A plan that names code existing nowhere in the codebase is refused.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 12. **Look at everything from the owner's side.** The owner works from a tablet app. Anything asked of the owner is only what only the owner can do, doable with a tap or a reply.
rules.says: The owner works from a tablet app, so anything asked of the owner is only what only the owner can do and is doable with a tap or a reply.
rules.live_quote: When work stops on something only the owner can do, say so as a need: that work is stopped, what is needed and where it is done, why, what it holds up, and what is not known.
rules.missing: That the owner works from a tablet app and that anything asked of the owner is doable with a tap or a reply.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Never directions to settings, a menu, a start-up script, a permission rule or an install.
rules.says: The session never gives the owner directions to settings, a menu, a start-up script, a permission rule or an install.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 13. **The main session is a manager.** It plans, sends agents, checks each result against the approved plan and the owner's messages, and reports.
rules.says: The main session is a manager that plans, sends agents, checks each result against the approved plan and the owner's messages, and reports, and does no work itself: implementation, tests, commits, pushes and workflow dispatches are done by agents.
rules.live_quote: This is for the session that manages. The session plans, sends and judges; workers do the steps.
rules.missing: That the main session does no implementation, tests, commits, pushes or workflow dispatches itself, and that it checks each result against the approved plan and the owner's messages.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: and a result that does not match the plan goes back.
rules.says: A result that does not match the approved plan is sent back to the agent.
rules.live_quote: On a fail, a worker fixes what the checker named and the checker looks again.
rules.missing: That the manager checks each result against the approved plan and sends back any result that does not match it; only a checker's failure is sent back live.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: An agent's prompt is only the approved plan's path and a step number, so everything an agent is told is in the plan the owner read. Added 2026-10-02.
rules.says: An agent's prompt is only the approved plan's path and a step number, so everything an agent is told is in the plan the owner read.
rules.live_quote: A worker is told the page and its step, nothing more.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: the manager fence in `hook-dispatch.mjs`. On the main thread (a call carrying no `agent_id`) it refuses every tool except: reads as `plan-guard.mjs` classifies them,
rules.says: On the main thread the manager fence refuses every tool except the listed few, where reads count only as plan-guard.mjs classifies them and sending an agent, a workflow, TaskStop, a plan-mode call and a file write never count as a read.

rules.heading: Rule 13: the manager fence
rules.quote: On the main thread (a call carrying no `agent_id`) it refuses every tool except:
rules.says: The main thread is a call carrying no agent_id, and on it the manager fence refuses every tool except those listed.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: then only reads of the record: a read of a file or a directory (Read, Grep, Glob, and each file a Bash line names) passes only of the approved plan and every file directly under `~/.claude/plans/`,
rules.says: The main thread may read only the record: the approved plan, files directly under ~/.claude/plans/, the session scratchpad, the hub's DOCTRINE.md, LESSONS.md, aim-review.md, agent-rules.md, lessons/ and plans/, the hub's and each sibling's CLAUDE.md, NOTES.md, .plan-scope, .claude/PLAN and .branch-guard, the session's own transcript under ~/.claude/projects/, and the live clone's doctrine; a read of any other file (a source file or an app's tool above all, or the GitHub connector's file contents or code search) is refused with a reason saying to send an agent, and sets no latch.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: a read that names no file, a tool search or a web read, passes as before;
rules.says: On the main thread a read that names no file, a tool search or a web read passes the fence.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: `SendUserFile` of files that sit in the session scratchpad, so a choice between pictures carries its pictures in the same message as the question (§2), and of no other path;
rules.says: The main thread may use SendUserFile only for files in the session scratchpad, so a choice between pictures carries its pictures in the same message as the question, and for no other path.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: sending an agent, through the dispatch gate; `TaskStop`;
rules.says: The main thread may send an agent only through the dispatch gate, and may use TaskStop.
rules.enforcer: manager fence, dispatch gate in hook-dispatch.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: `Artifact` publishing the status page and nothing else (`status/fix-run.html` in the session scratchpad, as a plain page), or reading, listing or opening a page, and never its quickstart action;
rules.says: The main thread may use Artifact only to publish the status page (status/fix-run.html in the session scratchpad, as a plain page) or to read, list or open a page, and never its quickstart action.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: the status command; a write to a plan file directly under `~/.claude/plans/`, to the status page's source or to the manager's notes for it (`status/manager.txt` in the session scratchpad);
rules.says: The main thread may run the status command and may write only to a plan file directly under ~/.claude/plans/, the status page's source, or the manager's notes for it (status/manager.txt in the session scratchpad).

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: `EnterPlanMode` and `ExitPlanMode`, so a plan can be amended after it lands;
rules.says: The main thread may use EnterPlanMode and ExitPlanMode, so a plan can be amended after it lands.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: and the wait between statuses (rule 2), `node ~/.claude/hub/report.mjs --wait` exactly, the live clone's `report.mjs` with that one flag and nothing chained to it.
rules.says: The wait between statuses is run on the main thread as exactly `node ~/.claude/hub/report.mjs --wait`, the live clone's report.mjs with that one flag and nothing chained to it.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The dispatch gate refuses an agent, or a message to one, whose prompt is anything but the approved plan's path and the number of a step in its `## Steps`;
rules.says: The dispatch gate refuses an agent, or a message to one, whose prompt is anything but the approved plan's path and the number of a step in its ## Steps.
rules.live_quote: A worker is told the page and its step, nothing more.
rules.missing: The dispatch gate that refuses an agent, or a message to one, whose prompt is anything but the approved plan's path and a step number from its ## Steps.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: where the plan has an `## Order` and no review step it also refuses any step but the pointer's N and the plan's Standing steps (rule 2), and the refusal prints N,
rules.says: Where the plan has an ## Order and no review step, only the pointer's step N and the plan's Standing steps may be sent and the refusal prints N so the next step is read and never chosen; an unreadable session or a plan with no ## Order has no pointer, and where the plan has a review step the pointer is not enforced and the review gate decides which step goes.
rules.enforcer: dispatch gate and review gate in hook-dispatch.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: it refuses an agent of a custom type, because a custom type carries instructions of its own; and it refuses every workflow, so no script of the session's carries instructions the owner has not read.
rules.says: The dispatch gate refuses an agent of a custom type and refuses every workflow, so nothing carries instructions the owner has not read.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The plan counts only while its hash matches the one recorded at approval: a plan edited after approval grants nothing.
rules.says: A plan counts only while its hash matches the one recorded at approval, and a plan edited after approval grants nothing.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A step number that was not in the plan's Steps at approval, which the marker records, is refused with a refusal that says the step needs the owner's button and sets no latch,
rules.says: A step number not in the plan's Steps at approval is refused with a refusal saying the step needs the owner's button and sets no latch, while an edit of a recorded step's text or of the Order of the recorded steps keeps the approval.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: `node ~/.claude/hub/hook-dispatch.mjs --can <tool> <path or command line>` prints whether the manager fence and the latch would pass that call on the main thread now, and why, and changes nothing;
rules.says: The command `node ~/.claude/hub/hook-dispatch.mjs --can <tool> <path or command line>` prints whether the fence and latch would pass a call on the main thread and why and changes nothing; it is accepted only spelled with the live clone's full path or the tilde path (any other spelling is refused naming those two, Q-HUB-405), the fence passes it alone and refuses it with anything chained, names it in every refusal of a non-record call, and the plan guard passes it in plan mode alone like the plan check.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: *Enforced whole by:* `approved-plan-guard.mjs` and `report.mjs`.
rules.says: Rule 13 as a whole is enforced by approved-plan-guard.mjs, report.mjs, hook-dispatch.mjs, plan-guard.mjs and plan-fence.mjs.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: *Enforced by:* `approved-plan-guard.mjs` and `report.mjs` (`SCOPE_SECTIONS`, `scopeChanged`): the plan's `## Rules` line and its `## Rules of this plan` section are part of the approved scope
rules.says: The plan's ## Rules line and ## Rules of this plan section are part of the approved scope with Goals, Asked, Files and Commands, so editing either after the button voids the approval and the plan goes back through plan mode; for a marker written before the two joined, the approval block says the marker does not record it and an edit is judged against the plan file as it stands.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A change to the agent rules file lands only when no plan is in force, as the last step of the plan that makes it, and no plan is moved to a new rules version without the button.**
rules.says: A change to the agent rules file lands only when no plan is in force, as the last step of the plan that makes it, and no plan is moved to a new rules version without the owner's button.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The version a plan pins is its Rules line, which is in the approved scope, so no amendment carries a new one; a send refused because the plan pins a version the file has moved past is answered by a new plan
rules.says: The rules version a plan pins is its Rules line, which is in the approved scope, so no amendment carries a new one; a send refused because the plan pins a version the file has moved past is answered by a new plan through plan mode with the current version pinned and the owner's button approves it.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The plan check (`node ~/.claude/hub/plan-guard.mjs --check <a plan of the record>`, rule 4) passes the manager fence and the latch the way the status command does,
rules.says: The plan check `node ~/.claude/hub/plan-guard.mjs --check <a plan of the record>` passes the manager fence and the latch like the status command, with nothing chained to it, and readsGate counts it as no send.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A step's Facts take a state from a read of the record made for the plan and never from an agent's report of it:
rules.says: A step's Facts take a state from a read of the record made for the plan and never from an agent's report of it, because a report is an agent's claim.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A call a gate must see goes in a turn of its own: a tool result returned in the same assistant turn is not yet in the transcript when a later call's hook in that turn runs,
rules.says: A call a gate must see goes in a turn of its own, on the main thread and in an agent alike, because a tool result returned in the same assistant turn is not yet in the transcript when a later call's hook runs, so a Read, note or Grep sent beside the judged call is not seen and the call is refused as unread.
rules.enforcer: gates that read an earlier call (Q-HUB-327)

rules.heading: Rule 13: a call a gate must see goes in its own turn
rules.quote: the refusal words of the gates that read an earlier call say so (the sixth finding of the take-up of 8 November, Q-HUB-327).
rules.says: The refusal words of the gates that read an earlier call must say that a call sent in the same turn as the read was not seen and is refused as unread.
rules.enforcer: the gates that read an earlier call (Q-HUB-327)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 14. **A refusal latches until the owner's next message.** A refusal by any guard, family or repo, ends that route for the thread that was refused:
rules.says: A refusal by any guard ends that route for the refused thread (the session if main, the agent alone if inside an agent) until the owner's next message; another command, tool or wording for the same end is the second route, not a fresh start; while latched the main thread says in plain text what was refused and stops, and an agent returns what it has with the refusal's text.
rules.live_quote: A refusal from a hook or the harness is an instruction. Stop that route, say plainly what was refused, word for word, and do not try another way to the same end.
rules.missing: That the refusal latches until the owner's next message, that it applies per thread (main session vs agent alone), that another command, tool or wording for the same end is the second route, that the main thread says what was refused and stops, and that an agent returns what it has with the refusal's text.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Twenty-five refusals are not ends of a route, and set no latch, because something other than the owner's next message answers each
rules.says: Twenty-five listed refusals set no latch because something other than the owner's next message answers each; the list is read from the code (main in hook-dispatch.mjs), each item with the name that sets it, and a case holds its count to the list.
rules.enforcer: main in hook-dispatch.mjs, a case holding the count
